note: Tuning values the sim reads from the TUNE section. A change here is a data edit: the engine reloads it
with the rest of the scenario. Every value must be present; a missing or out-of-range value refuses the map.
structure_scan_cells: cells a unit's bucket scan reaches past its weapon range (structures are bucketed at
their centre, beyond the footprint edge).
teleport_ring_points / teleport_ring_steps: landing ring for the teleport effect, directions and widening steps.
best_only: item stats that take the largest value any active item gives, instead of the sum.
xp_curve: cumulative xp at which character levels 2 to 25 are reached (level 1 needs none). UNVERIFIED: the
6.88g data holds no experience table; these values are recalled, not read from it.
